title: Seattle, the bathroom mirror
logline: The first Seattle apartment's bathroom, invented: a mirror over a sink, and in it nothing, because he doesn't know what she looked like at twenty in a mirror in a city. The page draws the mirror empty and the toothbrush cup with one brush.

panels.composition: A small apartment bathroom with a mirror over the sink reflecting an empty room, a cup on the sink holding a single toothbrush, tile.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small apartment bathroom with a mirror over the sink reflecting only an empty room and a cup on the sink holding a single toothbrush, tile, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The mirror empty because he doesn't know.
